items.informal_name: Natural Degree Bound for Evaluated Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type v} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {m n : ℕ} (F : MvPolynomial σ R),
  F.totalDegree ≤ m →
    ∀ (f : σ → Polynomial R), (∀ (i : σ), (f i).natDegree ≤ n) → ((MvPolynomial.aeval f) F).natDegree ≤ m * n
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a commutative semiring, $ \sigma $ an index type, and $ F \in R[\sigma] $ a multivariate polynomial with total degree $ \leq m $. If each variable in $ F $ is substituted by a univariate polynomial $ f_i \in R[X] $ with natural degree $ \leq n $, then the natural degree of the evaluated polynomial $ \text{aeval}(f)(F) $ is at most $ m \cdot n $. Formally, if $ F.\text{totalDegree} \leq m $ and $ \forall i, (f_i.\text{natDegree} \leq n) $, then $ (\text{aeval}\, f\, F).\text{natDegree} \leq m \cdot n $.

items.informal_name: Total Degree of Expanded Multivariate Polynomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {p : ℕ} (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ((MvPolynomial.expand p) f).totalDegree = f.totalDegree * p
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, and natural number $ p $, the total degree of the expanded polynomial $ \text{expand}_p(f) $ is equal to $ p $ times the total degree of the original polynomial $ f $. Here, $ \text{expand}_p $ denotes the algebra homomorphism that raises each variable in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ to the $ p $-th power.

items.informal_name: Degree Bound for Multivariate Polynomials in Chevalley's Theorem
items.informal_description: A function that computes a degree bound for multivariate polynomials, taking a natural number $n$, a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, and an element of the sum type $\mathbb{N} \oplus \mathbb{N}$. For left components, it applies $f$ to $n$, and for right components, it returns $n$ directly. This is used in the proof of Chevalley's theorem to establish well-founded recursion for multivariate polynomial constructions.

items.informal_name: Total Degree of Multivariate Polynomial Power Inequality
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ),
  (a ^ n).totalDegree ≤ n * a.totalDegree
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ a $ in variables $ \sigma $ over a commutative semiring $ R $, and for any natural number $ n $, the total degree of $ a^n $ satisfies $ \deg(a^n) \leq n \cdot \deg(a) $.

items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p q : Polynomial R}, (p.comp q).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree * q.natDegree
items.informal_description: For any polynomials $ p $ and $ q $ over a semiring $ R $, the natural degree of the composition $ p \circ q $ is less than or equal to the product of the natural degrees of $ p $ and $ q $, i.e., $ \deg(p \circ q) \leq \deg p \cdot \deg q $.
